title: Fix bugs in a Rust CSV parser
description: A Rust CSV parsing library has three bugs: wrong delimiter split, incorrect header skipping logic, and an integer parsing bug. Fix all three to make tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the three bugs in src/lib.rs:

1. parse_csv BUG 1: the split uses ',' always — change it to split on the given `delimiter` parameter
2. parse_csv BUG 2: skip_header removes the last row (pop) — change it to remove the first row (use drain or remove index 0)
3. row_to_ints BUG 3: parses as u32 which can't handle negative numbers — change to parse as i64

Run `cargo test` to verify all 4 tests pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
